text:
{"entries":[{"name_han":"...","logic_thesis":"...","logic_chain":"...","logic_practice":"...","logic_compare":"..."}]}{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "何典",
      "logic_thesis": "The work proves that bureaucratic morality, karmic accounting, and social hierarchy are structurally identical in the yin and yang worlds; therefore any claim that the underworld is 'other' is false. By staging fate through ghosts named as living vices, it demonstrates that destiny language (典, precedent, classic) can be emptied of substance while still governing behavior. The satirical isomorphism proves that reading fortune requires decoding power structures, not merely celestial symbols.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Official justice and family inheritance claim cosmic legitimacy. 2) If that legitimacy were real, the underworld mirror would show fair retribution. 3) Observation: ghost officials reproduce nepotism, empty rhetoric, and arbitrary force. 4) Inference: yin-yang is one continuous system of patterned injustice, not two moral regimes. 5) Therefore '典' (canonical rule) without lived integrity cannot correct fate. 6) Conclusion: fate analysis must include social-qi and institutional pattern, not natal symbols alone.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When a BaZi chart shows strong Officer/Kill, test whether the 'authority' is empty form or real virtue before advising career moves. 2) Map client family patterns across two generations as the novel maps two ghost generations—recurrence is evidence. 3) Treat slang, local custom, and unstated hierarchy as chart-adjacent data (earthly branch of lived life). 4) In cultivation, refuse 'underworld theater': do not outsource moral repair to ritual while repeating the same bureaucratic vice. 5) Use inversion reading: what the client mythologizes as fate may be institutional mimicry.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike straight zhiguai collections that treat ghosts as proof of retribution, 何典 uses ghosts as proof of structural continuity with human offices. It differs from pure morality books (善书) by refusing didactic closure: the logic is satirical isomorphism, not reward-punish tables. Why: dialect comedy and empty '典' expose that classical language can mask, not reveal, the real pattern of qi."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "池北偶谈",
      "logic_thesis": "Wang Shizhen’s miscellany proves that literary taste, political anecdote, and anomalous events belong to one evidentiary field for reading pattern. Chance talk (偶谈) is not noise: repeated odd cases function as statistical-moral sampling of fortune. The argument is epistemic: cultivated attention to the incidental yields more reliable destiny knowledge than rigid system alone.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Elite culture ranks formal history above stray notes. 2) Yet careers, omens, and talent judgments repeatedly appear in casual records. 3) If pattern is real, it must surface in both high and low genres. 4) Inference: the 'occasional' is a legitimate sensor for qi anomalies. 5) Cross-checked anecdotes converge on recurrent moral-fate links. 6) Conclusion: BaZi-style reasoning needs a notebook of lived cases, not only classics.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Keep a personal 偶谈 log of chart predictions vs outcomes; treat misses as data. 2) When a chart is ambiguous, gather three 'stray' life anecdotes before forcing a classical rule. 3) Use literary/artistic luck (食伤) stories in the text as templates for reading Output stars. 4) Train discernment: separate gossip from pattern by requiring recurrence. 5) In cultivation, practice 'north-pool stillness'—observe without immediately moralizing.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike systematic treatises (e.g. 开元占经), 池北偶谈 proves by accumulation of cases, not taxonomies. It differs from pure fiction (何典) by claiming reportage status for anomalies. Why: Wang’s poetics of 神韵 extends to fate—subtle resonance, not heavy doctrine, is the method."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "分甘余话",
      "logic_thesis": "The late-life 'sharing of remaining sweetness' proves that retrospective narrative is a superior instrument for verifying destiny claims made in youth. What remains after career heat cools is the durable pattern of allotment (分). The text argues that wisdom is residual and distributive: truth is what can still be shared when ambition’s sugar is gone.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Mid-career judgments are distorted by desire and faction. 2) Age reduces stake in self-advertisement. 3) Therefore late notes better isolate what was fated versus forced. 4) '余' (remainder) implies a sifted surplus of pattern. 5) Sharing that surplus tests whether the pattern is communicable, not private delusion. 6) Conclusion: fate verification requires a late, generous, residual viewpoint.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Re-read a client’s decade-old forecast only after a luck pillar has fully passed—use remainder logic. 2) In annual luck advice, distinguish 'peak sweetness' years from '余' years that reveal true structure. 3) Cultivation: practice non-hoarding of insight (分甘)—teaching clarifies your own chart reading. 4) When Day Master is weak late in life, shift method from conquest to distribution and mentorship. 5) Archive '余话'—secondary notes often hold the key contradiction the main reading missed.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 池北偶谈, this work is more autumnal and self-limiting: it proves by residual selection, not broad sampling. Unlike hagiographies that claim continuous ascent, 分甘余话 accepts decline as epistemic advantage. Why: the metaphor of shared sweetness encodes ethics into method—generosity is part of truth-testing."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "秋燈叢話",
      "logic_thesis": "Autumn-lamp talk proves that liminal conditions (seasonal decline + night light) make causal chains between conduct and anomaly visible. The collection argues that retribution and coincidence are not opposites: clustered strange cases under a weak light reveal moral physics. Darkness is not ignorance; controlled dimness focuses the pattern.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Full daylight social order hides secondary causes. 2) Autumn signifies harvest and settling of accounts. 3) Lamp-light is partial illumination—enough to see outline, not dazzle. 4) Under that regime, ghost/strange tales show repeated conduct→consequence maps. 5) Inference: timing (season) + attention mode (lamp) are part of the evidence procedure. 6) Conclusion: fate reading needs seasonal and liminal framing, not only static charts.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Prefer deep chart reviews in Metal/Water seasonal windows for clients with heavy Fire patterns—liminality aids honesty. 2) Use 'lamp method': limit data to 3–5 pivotal life events before expanding. 3) Track 冲合 of month branch against birth chart when anomalous dreams/events cluster. 4) Cultivation: night sitting with one lamp—reduce sensory excess to see karmic loops. 5) Treat 叢 (thicket) of cases as Bayesian update, not single-proof superstition.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike court-centered Tang stele theology of 感应, 秋燈叢話 proves response at household scale under weak light. It differs from 何典 by largely affirming retribution rather than satirizing its institutions. Why: the autumn-lamp frame is itself an argument about when truth appears—timing is method."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "蝶階外史",
      "logic_thesis": "Outer history on the butterfly steps proves that unofficial narrative captures qi-response and social destiny that official historiography systematically deletes. 'Outer' is not inferior: it is the complementary channel where pattern survives censorship and decorum. The butterfly motif implies transformation visible only at the margin of the hall.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Official history optimizes for legitimacy and continuity. 2) Optimization deletes anomaly, scandal, and folk causal claims. 3) Yet anomaly is where fate patterns are most informative. 4) Outer-historical writing reinserts deleted cases. 5) Inference: completeness of destiny knowledge requires 外史 as correction term. 6) Conclusion: BaZi practice must include unofficial life data against the 'official story' the client tells.",
      "logic_practice": "1) After hearing a client’s polished biography, solicit the 'outer history'—failures, affairs, illnesses omitted first. 2) Compare 官杀 narrative (title, rank) with 伤官/偏印 narrative (rebellion, side paths). 3) When charts contradict résumé, trust the chart and hunt outer facts. 4) Cultivation: walk the 蝶階—observe mind’s transformations at thresholds (steps), not only in the main hall of identity. 5) Document case notes as 外史 to your own theories so theory does not become official dogma.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 归庐谭往录, which is memoir from retirement, 蝶階外史 claims the structural necessity of marginal genres. It differs from 洞仙传 by staying mostly social-strange rather than immortality-certified. Why: 'outer' is a logical operator—completeness—rather than a mere publishing category."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "壺天錄",
      "logic_thesis": "Records from pot-heaven prove that a compressed microcosm (household, market, local rumor) contains the same structural laws as the grand cosmos. Daoist 'universe in a pot' is not metaphor only: pattern is scale-invariant. Therefore small cases are valid proofs for large principles of fortune and response.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Cosmology is often treated as elite/imperial sky science. 2) Daoist 壶天 claims full world inside limited vessel. 3) If laws are real, they must recur at small scale. 4) Local records of oddity, virtue, and disaster show the same 感应 grammar. 5) Inference: micro-evidence is not anecdotal waste; it is fractal sampling. 6) Conclusion: BaZi earthly branches (local fields) are as decisive as heavenly stems (sky principles).",
      "logic_practice": "1) Read Day Branch as 壶天—the vessel of lived microcosm—before over-weighting year stem politics. 2) Use neighborhood/family cluster events as confirmation of 行运 shifts. 3) In cultivation, practice 'pot work': one room, one breath cycle, full cosmos. 4) Prefer concrete local remedies (home, schedule, diet) over abstract grand narratives when chart shows strong earth/vessel imagery. 5) Collect micro-cases to calibrate rules instead of importing only imperial omens.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 开元占经’s sky-to-state taxonomy, 壺天錄 argues validity from the bottom up. It differs from 太上混元老子史略, which expands origin to cosmic history; here the cosmos shrinks into the pot without loss. Why: scale-invariance is the distinctive logical claim."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "昔柳摭談",
      "logic_thesis": "Picking talks under former willows proves that nostalgic framing does not invalidate pattern recovery; it filters it. Memory bent by longing still yields extractable regularities of fortune if the picker (摭) is methodical. The text argues against pure presentism: past talk is a mine, not a fog.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Nostalgia is suspected of distortion. 2) Distortion is real but patterned, not random. 3) Methodical gleaning can separate emotional color from event skeleton. 4) Willow-past scenes repeatedly host the same social-fate motifs. 5) Inference: temporal distance plus selective picking improves signal for some classes of truth. 6) Conclusion: retrospective BaZi audit is valid when gleaning rules are explicit.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When rectifying birth time, use emotionally charged old memories as anchors—then cross-check with neutral public dates. 2) Separate 'willow tone' (sentiment) from 'event nodes' (moves, deaths, exams). 3) For 桃花/沐浴 patterns, expect nostalgia bias; demand third-party confirmation. 4) Cultivation: sit with memory without rewriting it—摭, don’t fabricate. 5) Build a timeline of 10 past luck nodes before forecasting the next decade.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 分甘余话’s residual-sharing ethic, 昔柳摭談 emphasizes gleaning technique under nostalgia’s tree. It differs from 归庐谭往录’s career-closure memoir by being more fragmentary and scene-based. Why: the willow is a logical filter—beauty that both conceals and preserves."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "金壺七墨",
      "logic_thesis": "Seven inks from one golden pot prove that multi-genre writing (news, poetry, strange, politics, travel) converges on a single moral-fate calculus. Diversity of ink is not diversity of law: the pot unifies. The argument is that reality’s pattern forces different literary tools to draw the same structure.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Genres claim separate truth standards. 2) One authorial vessel holds seven modes. 3) Across modes, retribution, talent, and political luck rhyme. 4) Inference: the rhyme is evidence of an underlying invariant, not stylistic habit alone. 5) If invariants hold across genres, they are candidates for cosmological law. 6) Conclusion: BaZi synthesis should multi-source (event, speech, art, health) into one pot without category confusion.",
      "logic_practice": "1) For each chart, require evidence from at least three 'inks': career, body, speech/art, relationship, sudden anomaly. 2) When only one domain fits the reading, mark confidence low—pot not yet full. 3) Use 七 as a checklist (七政-style): don’t stop at wealth star alone. 4) Cultivation: one vessel, multiple expressions—unify intent across roles. 5) Avoid single-genre superstition (only dreams, only exams, only ghosts).",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 池北偶谈’s occasional unity, 金壺七墨 makes multi-ink unity the explicit architecture. It differs from 串雅, which unifies folk and elite medicine, by unifying literary genres around civic-moral fate. Why: the golden pot is the thesis—container precedes and disciplines the seven tools."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "歸廬譚往錄",
      "logic_thesis": "Talking of the past upon returning to the hut proves that exit from the field of power is a precondition for undistorted destiny review. Return (歸) is not mere retirement: it is a methodological reset of observer position. The hut is the logical site where 'what was forcing' separates from 'what was allotted'.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Inside office, speech is strategic. 2) Strategy mixes with fate narrative, contaminating both. 3) Leaving the field reduces strategic pressure. 4) Hut talk can re-sequence past events under lower bias. 5) Inference: observer position is part of the validity conditions for fortune knowledge. 6) Conclusion: serious BaZi audit requires a 歸廬 phase—distance from the stake.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Schedule major life-chart reviews after job exits, breakups, or moves—not at peak campaign. 2) Build a 'hut protocol': no advice for 7 days, only chronology reconstruction. 3) Identify which decade stems were 'office masks' vs true Day Master needs. 4) Cultivation: periodic 归庐—retreat to test which desires survive silence. 5) For clients still inside power games, mark readings as provisional (高偏差).",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 分甘余话, which distributes residual sweetness socially, 歸廬譚往錄 centers spatial-social withdrawal as epistemic tool. It differs from immortal hagiography’s permanent exit: the hut can still talk of the world. Why: 往 (the past) is only cleanly readable after 歸."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "兩般秋雨盦隨筆",
      "logic_thesis": "Brush notes from a studio of 'two kinds' of autumn rain prove that parallel aesthetic and cognitive frames can be held without forcing a single reduction. Duality here is not contradiction: it is calibrated binocular vision on culture and fate. The argument validates non-exclusive reading modes—classic vs contemporary, elegant vs vulgar—under one roof.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Scholars often demand one orthodoxy of taste and omen. 2) Lived culture presents simultaneous 'two rains'. 3) A studio that houses both records richer pattern. 4) Inference: binocular method reduces blind spots of monocular schools. 5) Cross-illumination of the two frames yields stabler judgments. 6) Conclusion: BaZi schools (e.g. classical rules vs empirical statistics) should be dual-run, not tribal.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Always produce two readings: rule-first and case-first; reconcile only after both. 2) For 杂气 months and combined stems, accept dual viable narratives until luck proves one. 3) Train '两般' attention: client’s self-story and chart’s counter-story. 4) Cultivation: sit through changing rain—same pavilion, multiple weathers of mind. 5) Refuse false unity that erases a contradictory useful signal.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 金壺七墨’s multi-ink unity under one law, 兩般秋雨盦隨筆 preserves productive duality longer. It differs from dogmatic lineage manuals that collapse methods early. Why: '两般' is the logical operator—parallel frames as method, not indecision."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "串雅",
      "logic_thesis": "Zhao Xuemin’s linking of folk remedies into 'elegance' proves that vernacular technique contains systematic efficacy equal in kind to classical pharmacy. The argument is against pedigree fetish: pattern of symptom→response can be formalized from the street. Thus knowledge legitimacy follows verification chains (串), not only classical citation.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Elite medicine dismisses folk craft as vulgar. 2) Clinical results recur in folk practice. 3) Recurrence implies structure. 4) Structure can be collated, named, and tested (串→雅). 5) Inference: elegance is formalization of what works, not birth in the academy. 6) Conclusion: BaZi must admit empirical folk timing lore when it survives testing, and reject classical lines that fail cases.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Maintain a dual pharmacopeia of rules: canonical stem-branch laws and field-tested folk maxims—tag confidence levels. 2) When a classical god-killing rule fails thrice, demote it as 串雅 would demote empty theory. 3) Translate body symptoms into Five Phase imbalance as Zhao links herb and sign. 4) Cultivation: respect low-status skills (massage, breath folkways) as valid 术. 5) Document chains: symptom → intervention → outcome → chart factor.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure literary biji, 串雅 proves by clinical pragmatics. It differs from 开元占经’s sky taxonomy by working on the body-street interface. Why: 串 is the logic—serialization and linking of working fragments into a dignified system without erasing origin."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君年谱要略",
      "logic_thesis": "The chronological outline of Lord Lao proves that the Dao can be presented as a serial incarnational timeline without reducing it to mere human biography. Historicization is a pedagogical and ritual technology: cosmic principle becomes legible as dated responsiveness. The argument: time-binding of the sacred enables political-personal alignment with the Way.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Dao is often claimed as timeless and unnarratable. 2) Communities still need dated forms for worship and legitimacy. 3) A nianpu formats the formless into sequence. 4) Sequence allows correlation with dynasties, omens, and personal calendars. 5) Inference: sacred time series is a bridge between metaphysics and mantic practice. 6) Conclusion: BaZi’s calendar is continuous with Daoist historicization of the cosmic person.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Treat major luck pillars as personal 'nianpu of the Dao'—chapters of one principle in different masks. 2) When advising, date transformations; avoid eternal abstractions without year nodes. 3) Align ritual/cultivation intensives with chart-supported years as the nianpu aligns theophany with eras. 4) Study Laozi’s multiple appearances as model for Day Master expressing through different 十神 roles. 5) Use outline (要略) discipline: compress client life to essential dated nodes first.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 太上混元老子史略, which emphasizes primordial fusion (混元), the 年谱要略 prioritizes dated serial form. It differs from 洞仙传’s many-person immortality catalog by centering one cosmic identity across times. Why: chronology itself is the proof structure."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上混元老子史略",
      "logic_thesis": "The historical outline of Hunyuan Laozi proves that primordial chaos-unity (混元) and the named sage Laozi are one continuum, not two subjects. Origin metaphysics and biographical history collapse into a single causal story: the world unfolds from mixed origin through a teaching person. Thus personal cultivation aims to reverse-engineer biography back into 混元.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Philosophy splits 'principle' from 'person'. 2) Daoist history fuses them as 混元老子. 3) If fusion is true, reading either alone is partial. 4) Cosmogony→sage acts→teaching transmission form one chain. 5) Inference: fate of persons participates in cosmogonic leftover order. 6) Conclusion: BaZi charts are local crystallizations of 混元 differentiation (阴阳五行), readable toward re-integration.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Begin advanced readings from Taiji/混元: before listing gods, state the chart’s primary polar tension. 2) Practice reverse sequence: from current events back to Day Master root, then to prenatal Taiji image. 3) Cultivation: hunyuan breathing—mix, don’t chase single phase peaks. 4) When many 十神 clutter, re-merge categories until one generative conflict remains. 5) Use '史略' compression: refuse trivia that doesn’t serve origin logic.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 年谱要略, this text’s logic is cosmogonic fusion more than date tables. Unlike 玄元十子图, which multiplies disciples, it unifies identity at the source. Why: 混元 is the master operator—mixture prior to and within history."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "洞仙传",
      "logic_thesis": "Biographies of cave immortals prove that localized sacred space (洞天) plus practice can rewrite the apparent finality of ordinary destiny. The collection argues by case gallery: transformation is plural in method but unitary in structure (exit ordinary calibration). Immortality narrative functions as existence proof for non-linear fate.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Ordinary biography ends in decay and social closure. 2) Cave-heaven practice reports alternate endings. 3) Multiple independent cases share motifs: discipline, locale, transmission, verification signs. 4) Shared motifs imply a trainable pattern, not unique miracle. 5) Inference: allotment (命) is conditional on practice regime and place-qi. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 'fixed fate' is a baseline; cultivation is a legal amendment procedure within Daoist physics.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Identify chart 'cave entries': 印星, mountains, solitude, study—portals for rewrite. 2) Prescribe place and schedule (洞天 analogue: retreat room, hours) matching favorable branches. 3) Track verification signs (health, dream, synchronicity) as hagiographies track proofs. 4) For heavy 伤官 without output path, design a craft-immortality route (skill as ascent). 5) Never promise literal transcendence; use the structure: baseline chart → practice amendment → re-measured outcomes.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike imperial steles that prove 感应 for dynasty, 洞仙传 proves it for private ascent. It differs from 徐神翁语录, which stresses knowing allotted number, by stressing transformation narratives. Why: the cave is a logic of spatial exception—place enables exception to average fate."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "虚静冲和先生徐神翁语录",
      "logic_thesis": "Xu Shenweng’s recorded sayings prove that human use of life is bounded by heaven, allotment, portion, and number (天/命/分/数), which cannot be altered by raw will; ignorance of principle creates the need for a seer who has already obtained the mind-pattern. Divination is not creation of fate but disclosure of a pre-structured field. Stillness and harmony (虚静冲和) are the epistemic virtues that make disclosure accurate.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: People experience life as choosable at every point. 2) Outcomes repeatedly show fixed bounds (分定). 3) Failure to '穷理' yields self-ignorance. 4) One who has prior grasp of the pattern can speak fortune/misfortune reliably. 5) Inference: mantic authority rests on mind-alignment, not performance tricks. 6) Conclusion: BaZi practice must combine numerical structure with 虚静—without stillness, number becomes noise.",
      "logic_practice": "1) State client constraints (分/数) before strategies; refuse 'anything is possible' coaching. 2) Pre-reading protocol: 虚静—breath and empty agenda, then open the chart. 3) When 冲和 is missing (internal conflict), delay prediction; regulate first. 4) Teach clients which sectors are hard allotment vs soft timing. 5) Model Xu’s low status service (sweeping) as training: humble roles refine perception of pattern.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 洞仙传’s rewrite-through-ascent gallery, Xu’s logic prioritizes knowing the allotted measure. It differs from 开元占经’s vast external omen tables by centering the seer’s 虚静 mind as instrument. Why: the yu lu form proves through aphoristic cases that fate-disclosure is ethical-epistemic, not merely technical."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "玄元十子图",
      "logic_thesis": "Portraits and lives of the Ten Masters of Mysterious Origin prove that one Dao-source generates multiple valid disciple temperaments and methods. Diversity of transmission is evidence of the source’s fertility, not of schism alone. Image + biography together argue that lineage is a structured plurality under Xuanyuan.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Orthodoxy often collapses into one heir style. 2) Ten named disciples embody distinct approaches from one Laozi-root. 3) Portraiture freezes difference as simultaneous truth. 4) Shared origin + distinct paths imply generative unity. 5) Inference: evaluating a path requires locating which '子' function it enacts. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 十神 can be read as disciple-functions of one Day Master origin—plural roles, one root.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Map client’s strong 十神 to disciple archetypes (e.g. 食伤 as free wanderer type, 正官 as order-keeper type). 2) Advise path diversification when chart shows multiple viable outputs—don’t force one school. 3) Use image-meditation: visualize roles rather than only verbal rules. 4) Cultivation: study one classic per 'disciple gate' to avoid monocular Dao. 5) In teacher selection, match temperament (子) to chart, not fame alone.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 太上老君年谱’s single-identity serial timeline, 玄元十子图 multiplies persons under one title. It differs from 洞仙传’s open immortal crowd by fixed decade of philosophical heirs. Why: the number ten and the portrait genre are logical devices for structured plurality."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "大唐嵩阳观纪圣德感应之颂",
      "logic_thesis": "The Songyang Abbey stele proves that imperial virtue and Daoist sanctuary co-produce publicly testable 感应 (stimulus-response) between human order and cosmic power. Sacred architecture and political morality form a joint experimental apparatus: when virtue is claimed, heaven’s response is inscribed as evidence. Legitimacy is argued as reciprocal causation, not mere force.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Dynasty claims mandate. 2) Mandate requires non-human confirmation. 3) Daoist holy site is designated sensor and amplifier. 4) Recorded wonders link royal de/virtue to cosmic reply. 5) Inference: politics and cultivation share one response physics. 6) Conclusion: BaZi state-luck and personal luck both obey 感应 pairing—inner quality with outer timing.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Pair any major luck claim with a virtue/conduct variable—don’t predict from symbols alone. 2) Treat temples, mountains, and fixed altars as chart-external nodes of 得地. 3) For leaders’ charts, read 官印 as Songyang-type apparatus: institution as response surface. 4) Cultivation: make one practice site stable enough to 'inscribe' results over years. 5) When 感应 fails, audit virtue and site before rewriting theory.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike private 洞仙传 proofs, this is public-imperial demonstration literature. It differs from 升仙太子碑 by focusing on abbey-state resonance rather than a single apotheosized prince. Why: the genre is 颂—praise as logical seal on the response experiment."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "升仙太子碑",
      "logic_thesis": "The Stele of the Crown Prince Who Ascended to Immortality proves that political authority can bind itself to a personal apotheosis narrative, making transcendence a technology of rule and of aspiration simultaneously. Wu Zhao’s inscription argues that history, calligraphy, and ritual stone fix a pathway from mortal rank to immortal status. The proof structure is performative: the stele does not only report ascent—it institutes it as model.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Rank alone does not guarantee sacred permanence. 2) Immortalization narrative supplies permanence. 3) Stone inscription publicizes and stabilizes the narrative. 4) Sovereign sponsorship fuses state cult with personal ascent template. 5) Inference: fate elevation can be ritually-politically engineered within Daoist symbolic law. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 'rising' luck includes symbolic-institutional acts, not only silent waiting for stems.",
      "logic_practice": "1) For charts with strong 食伤 + 官, design a visible masterwork (stele-analogue) that locks identity transformation. 2) Time publications, renamings, and vows to supportive luck pillars. 3) Distinguish empty self-myth from stele-logic: public verifiable change + craft. 4) Cultivation: write a personal '碑'—concise vows and evidence of practice. 5) Read 羊刃/权 patterns carefully: ascent rhetoric can mask coercion; demand ethical alignment.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 龙角山庆唐观纪圣铭, which sacralizes dynasty founding theophany, this stele personalizes ascent in a princely figure under female sovereign authorship. It differs from 洞仙传 by being a single monumental proof-object. Why: the stele medium is the argument—durability as logical force."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "龙角山庆唐观纪圣铭",
      "logic_thesis": "The Longjiao Mountain inscription proves that Tang founding is to be read as cosmological theophany, not merely military success: dynasty birth is a Daoist event with site, vision, and commemorative abbey. Sacred geography certifies political origin. The argument binds mountain qi, ancestral spirit signs, and state cult into one causal bundle.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Conquest narratives risk looking like contingent violence. 2) Theophany narratives reframe conquest as response to higher order. 3) Fixed mountain and abbey provide permanent coordinates for the claim. 4) Inscription freezes the origin story as ongoing cult. 5) Inference: origin qi of a polity (or person) needs a geographic-ritual anchor. 6) Conclusion: BaZi year pillar / ancestral palace reading should include place of origin and cultic memory, not only numerical stems.",

  "entries": [
    {
      "title": "何典",
      "author": "蒲松龄",
      "year": "约 1679",
      "core_proof": "Satirical novel using ghost realm as mirror of human world proves that moral/karmic structures of officialdom are isomorphic across yin-yang; language and \"典\" (classics/precedents) can be empty shells; fate of ghosts mirrors bureaucratic destiny."

    {
      "title": "池北偶谈",
      "author": "王士祯",
      "year": "1684",
      "core proof": "Wang Shizhen's biji proves that odd events, destiny signs, and literary judgments form a continuous evidentiary field; anecdote is a legitimate epistemic mode for pattern recognition of fortune.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that bureaucratic morality, karmic accounting, and social hierarchy are structurally identical in the yin and yang worlds; therefore any claim that the underworld is 'other' is false. By staging fate through ghosts named as living vices, it demonstrates that destiny language (典, precedent, classic) can be emptied of substance while still governing behavior. The satirical isomorphism proves that reading fortune requires decoding power structures, not merely celestial symbols.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Official justice and family inheritance claim cosmic legitimacy. 2) If that legitimacy were real, the underworld mirror would show fair retribution. 3) Observation: ghost officials reproduce nepotism, empty rhetoric, and arbitrary force. 4) Inference: yin-yang is one continuous system of patterned injustice, not two moral regimes. 5) Therefore '典' (canonical rule) without lived integrity cannot correct fate. 6) Conclusion: fate analysis must include social-qi and institutional pattern, not natal symbols alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When a BaZi chart shows strong Officer/Kill, test whether the 'authority' is empty form or real virtue before advising career moves. 2) Map client family patterns across two generations as the novel maps two ghost generations—recurrence is evidence. 3) Treat slang, local custom, and unstated hierarchy as chart-adjacent data (earthly branch of lived life). 4) In cultivation, refuse 'underworld theater': do not outsource moral repair to ritual while repeating the same bureaucratic vice. 5) Use inversion reading: what the client mythologizes as fate may be institutional mimicry.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike straight zhiguai collections that treat ghosts as proof of retribution, 何典 uses ghosts as proof of structural continuity with human offices. It differs from pure morality books (善书) by refusing didactic closure: the logic is satirical isomorphism, not reward-punish tables. Why: dialect comedy and empty '典' expose that classical language can mask, not reveal, the real pattern of qi.

entries.logic_thesis: Wang Shizhen’s miscellany proves that literary taste, political anecdote, and anomalous events belong to one evidentiary field for reading pattern. Chance talk (偶谈) is not noise: repeated odd cases function as statistical-moral sampling of fortune. The argument is epistemic: cultivated attention to the incidental yields more reliable destiny knowledge than rigid system alone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Elite culture ranks formal history above stray notes. 2) Yet careers, omens, and talent judgments repeatedly appear in casual records. 3) If pattern is real, it must surface in both high and low genres. 4) Inference: the 'occasional' is a legitimate sensor for qi anomalies. 5) Cross-checked anecdotes converge on recurrent moral-fate links. 6) Conclusion: BaZi-style reasoning needs a notebook of lived cases, not only classics.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Keep a personal 偶谈 log of chart predictions vs outcomes; treat misses as data. 2) When a chart is ambiguous, gather three 'stray' life anecdotes before forcing a classical rule. 3) Use literary/artistic luck (食伤) stories in the text as templates for reading Output stars. 4) Train discernment: separate gossip from pattern by requiring recurrence. 5) In cultivation, practice 'north-pool stillness'—observe without immediately moralizing.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike systematic treatises (e.g. 开元占经), 池北偶谈 proves by accumulation of cases, not taxonomies. It differs from pure fiction (何典) by claiming reportage status for anomalies. Why: Wang’s poetics of 神韵 extends to fate—subtle resonance, not heavy doctrine, is the method.

entries.logic_thesis: The late-life 'sharing of remaining sweetness' proves that retrospective narrative is a superior instrument for verifying destiny claims made in youth. What remains after career heat cools is the durable pattern of allotment (分). The text argues that wisdom is residual and distributive: truth is what can still be shared when ambition’s sugar is gone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Mid-career judgments are distorted by desire and faction. 2) Age reduces stake in self-advertisement. 3) Therefore late notes better isolate what was fated versus forced. 4) '余' (remainder) implies a sifted surplus of pattern. 5) Sharing that surplus tests whether the pattern is communicable, not private delusion. 6) Conclusion: fate verification requires a late, generous, residual viewpoint.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Re-read a client’s decade-old forecast only after a luck pillar has fully passed—use remainder logic. 2) In annual luck advice, distinguish 'peak sweetness' years from '余' years that reveal true structure. 3) Cultivation: practice non-hoarding of insight (分甘)—teaching clarifies your own chart reading. 4) When Day Master is weak late in life, shift method from conquest to distribution and mentorship. 5) Archive '余话'—secondary notes often hold the key contradiction the main reading missed.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 池北偶谈, this work is more autumnal and self-limiting: it proves by residual selection, not broad sampling. Unlike hagiographies that claim continuous ascent, 分甘余话 accepts decline as epistemic advantage. Why: the metaphor of shared sweetness encodes ethics into method—generosity is part of truth-testing.

entries.logic_thesis: Autumn-lamp talk proves that liminal conditions (seasonal decline + night light) make causal chains between conduct and anomaly visible. The collection argues that retribution and coincidence are not opposites: clustered strange cases under a weak light reveal moral physics. Darkness is not ignorance; controlled dimness focuses the pattern.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Full daylight social order hides secondary causes. 2) Autumn signifies harvest and settling of accounts. 3) Lamp-light is partial illumination—enough to see outline, not dazzle. 4) Under that regime, ghost/strange tales show repeated conduct→consequence maps. 5) Inference: timing (season) + attention mode (lamp) are part of the evidence procedure. 6) Conclusion: fate reading needs seasonal and liminal framing, not only static charts.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Prefer deep chart reviews in Metal/Water seasonal windows for clients with heavy Fire patterns—liminality aids honesty. 2) Use 'lamp method': limit data to 3–5 pivotal life events before expanding. 3) Track 冲合 of month branch against birth chart when anomalous dreams/events cluster. 4) Cultivation: night sitting with one lamp—reduce sensory excess to see karmic loops. 5) Treat 叢 (thicket) of cases as Bayesian update, not single-proof superstition.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike court-centered Tang stele theology of 感应, 秋燈叢話 proves response at household scale under weak light. It differs from 何典 by largely affirming retribution rather than satirizing its institutions. Why: the autumn-lamp frame is itself an argument about when truth appears—timing is method.

entries.logic_thesis: Outer history on the butterfly steps proves that unofficial narrative captures qi-response and social destiny that official historiography systematically deletes. 'Outer' is not inferior: it is the complementary channel where pattern survives censorship and decorum. The butterfly motif implies transformation visible only at the margin of the hall.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Official history optimizes for legitimacy and continuity. 2) Optimization deletes anomaly, scandal, and folk causal claims. 3) Yet anomaly is where fate patterns are most informative. 4) Outer-historical writing reinserts deleted cases. 5) Inference: completeness of destiny knowledge requires 外史 as correction term. 6) Conclusion: BaZi practice must include unofficial life data against the 'official story' the client tells.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After hearing a client’s polished biography, solicit the 'outer history'—failures, affairs, illnesses omitted first. 2) Compare 官杀 narrative (title, rank) with 伤官/偏印 narrative (rebellion, side paths). 3) When charts contradict résumé, trust the chart and hunt outer facts. 4) Cultivation: walk the 蝶階—observe mind’s transformations at thresholds (steps), not only in the main hall of identity. 5) Document case notes as 外史 to your own theories so theory does not become official dogma.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 归庐谭往录, which is memoir from retirement, 蝶階外史 claims the structural necessity of marginal genres. It differs from 洞仙传 by staying mostly social-strange rather than immortality-certified. Why: 'outer' is a logical operator—completeness—rather than a mere publishing category.

entries.logic_thesis: Records from pot-heaven prove that a compressed microcosm (household, market, local rumor) contains the same structural laws as the grand cosmos. Daoist 'universe in a pot' is not metaphor only: pattern is scale-invariant. Therefore small cases are valid proofs for large principles of fortune and response.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Cosmology is often treated as elite/imperial sky science. 2) Daoist 壶天 claims full world inside limited vessel. 3) If laws are real, they must recur at small scale. 4) Local records of oddity, virtue, and disaster show the same 感应 grammar. 5) Inference: micro-evidence is not anecdotal waste; it is fractal sampling. 6) Conclusion: BaZi earthly branches (local fields) are as decisive as heavenly stems (sky principles).
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read Day Branch as 壶天—the vessel of lived microcosm—before over-weighting year stem politics. 2) Use neighborhood/family cluster events as confirmation of 行运 shifts. 3) In cultivation, practice 'pot work': one room, one breath cycle, full cosmos. 4) Prefer concrete local remedies (home, schedule, diet) over abstract grand narratives when chart shows strong earth/vessel imagery. 5) Collect micro-cases to calibrate rules instead of importing only imperial omens.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 开元占经’s sky-to-state taxonomy, 壺天錄 argues validity from the bottom up. It differs from 太上混元老子史略, which expands origin to cosmic history; here the cosmos shrinks into the pot without loss. Why: scale-invariance is the distinctive logical claim.

entries.logic_thesis: Picking talks under former willows proves that nostalgic framing does not invalidate pattern recovery; it filters it. Memory bent by longing still yields extractable regularities of fortune if the picker (摭) is methodical. The text argues against pure presentism: past talk is a mine, not a fog.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Nostalgia is suspected of distortion. 2) Distortion is real but patterned, not random. 3) Methodical gleaning can separate emotional color from event skeleton. 4) Willow-past scenes repeatedly host the same social-fate motifs. 5) Inference: temporal distance plus selective picking improves signal for some classes of truth. 6) Conclusion: retrospective BaZi audit is valid when gleaning rules are explicit.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When rectifying birth time, use emotionally charged old memories as anchors—then cross-check with neutral public dates. 2) Separate 'willow tone' (sentiment) from 'event nodes' (moves, deaths, exams). 3) For 桃花/沐浴 patterns, expect nostalgia bias; demand third-party confirmation. 4) Cultivation: sit with memory without rewriting it—摭, don’t fabricate. 5) Build a timeline of 10 past luck nodes before forecasting the next decade.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 分甘余话’s residual-sharing ethic, 昔柳摭談 emphasizes gleaning technique under nostalgia’s tree. It differs from 归庐谭往录’s career-closure memoir by being more fragmentary and scene-based. Why: the willow is a logical filter—beauty that both conceals and preserves.

entries.logic_thesis: Seven inks from one golden pot prove that multi-genre writing (news, poetry, strange, politics, travel) converges on a single moral-fate calculus. Diversity of ink is not diversity of law: the pot unifies. The argument is that reality’s pattern forces different literary tools to draw the same structure.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Genres claim separate truth standards. 2) One authorial vessel holds seven modes. 3) Across modes, retribution, talent, and political luck rhyme. 4) Inference: the rhyme is evidence of an underlying invariant, not stylistic habit alone. 5) If invariants hold across genres, they are candidates for cosmological law. 6) Conclusion: BaZi synthesis should multi-source (event, speech, art, health) into one pot without category confusion.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For each chart, require evidence from at least three 'inks': career, body, speech/art, relationship, sudden anomaly. 2) When only one domain fits the reading, mark confidence low—pot not yet full. 3) Use 七 as a checklist (七政-style): don’t stop at wealth star alone. 4) Cultivation: one vessel, multiple expressions—unify intent across roles. 5) Avoid single-genre superstition (only dreams, only exams, only ghosts).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 池北偶谈’s occasional unity, 金壺七墨 makes multi-ink unity the explicit architecture. It differs from 串雅, which unifies folk and elite medicine, by unifying literary genres around civic-moral fate. Why: the golden pot is the thesis—container precedes and disciplines the seven tools.

entries.logic_thesis: Talking of the past upon returning to the hut proves that exit from the field of power is a precondition for undistorted destiny review. Return (歸) is not mere retirement: it is a methodological reset of observer position. The hut is the logical site where 'what was forcing' separates from 'what was allotted'.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Inside office, speech is strategic. 2) Strategy mixes with fate narrative, contaminating both. 3) Leaving the field reduces strategic pressure. 4) Hut talk can re-sequence past events under lower bias. 5) Inference: observer position is part of the validity conditions for fortune knowledge. 6) Conclusion: serious BaZi audit requires a 歸廬 phase—distance from the stake.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Schedule major life-chart reviews after job exits, breakups, or moves—not at peak campaign. 2) Build a 'hut protocol': no advice for 7 days, only chronology reconstruction. 3) Identify which decade stems were 'office masks' vs true Day Master needs. 4) Cultivation: periodic 归庐—retreat to test which desires survive silence. 5) For clients still inside power games, mark readings as provisional (高偏差).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 分甘余话, which distributes residual sweetness socially, 歸廬譚往錄 centers spatial-social withdrawal as epistemic tool. It differs from immortal hagiography’s permanent exit: the hut can still talk of the world. Why: 往 (the past) is only cleanly readable after 歸.

entries.logic_thesis: Brush notes from a studio of 'two kinds' of autumn rain prove that parallel aesthetic and cognitive frames can be held without forcing a single reduction. Duality here is not contradiction: it is calibrated binocular vision on culture and fate. The argument validates non-exclusive reading modes—classic vs contemporary, elegant vs vulgar—under one roof.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Scholars often demand one orthodoxy of taste and omen. 2) Lived culture presents simultaneous 'two rains'. 3) A studio that houses both records richer pattern. 4) Inference: binocular method reduces blind spots of monocular schools. 5) Cross-illumination of the two frames yields stabler judgments. 6) Conclusion: BaZi schools (e.g. classical rules vs empirical statistics) should be dual-run, not tribal.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Always produce two readings: rule-first and case-first; reconcile only after both. 2) For 杂气 months and combined stems, accept dual viable narratives until luck proves one. 3) Train '两般' attention: client’s self-story and chart’s counter-story. 4) Cultivation: sit through changing rain—same pavilion, multiple weathers of mind. 5) Refuse false unity that erases a contradictory useful signal.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 金壺七墨’s multi-ink unity under one law, 兩般秋雨盦隨筆 preserves productive duality longer. It differs from dogmatic lineage manuals that collapse methods early. Why: '两般' is the logical operator—parallel frames as method, not indecision.

entries.logic_thesis: Zhao Xuemin’s linking of folk remedies into 'elegance' proves that vernacular technique contains systematic efficacy equal in kind to classical pharmacy. The argument is against pedigree fetish: pattern of symptom→response can be formalized from the street. Thus knowledge legitimacy follows verification chains (串), not only classical citation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Elite medicine dismisses folk craft as vulgar. 2) Clinical results recur in folk practice. 3) Recurrence implies structure. 4) Structure can be collated, named, and tested (串→雅). 5) Inference: elegance is formalization of what works, not birth in the academy. 6) Conclusion: BaZi must admit empirical folk timing lore when it survives testing, and reject classical lines that fail cases.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Maintain a dual pharmacopeia of rules: canonical stem-branch laws and field-tested folk maxims—tag confidence levels. 2) When a classical god-killing rule fails thrice, demote it as 串雅 would demote empty theory. 3) Translate body symptoms into Five Phase imbalance as Zhao links herb and sign. 4) Cultivation: respect low-status skills (massage, breath folkways) as valid 术. 5) Document chains: symptom → intervention → outcome → chart factor.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure literary biji, 串雅 proves by clinical pragmatics. It differs from 开元占经’s sky taxonomy by working on the body-street interface. Why: 串 is the logic—serialization and linking of working fragments into a dignified system without erasing origin.

entries.logic_thesis: The chronological outline of Lord Lao proves that the Dao can be presented as a serial incarnational timeline without reducing it to mere human biography. Historicization is a pedagogical and ritual technology: cosmic principle becomes legible as dated responsiveness. The argument: time-binding of the sacred enables political-personal alignment with the Way.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Dao is often claimed as timeless and unnarratable. 2) Communities still need dated forms for worship and legitimacy. 3) A nianpu formats the formless into sequence. 4) Sequence allows correlation with dynasties, omens, and personal calendars. 5) Inference: sacred time series is a bridge between metaphysics and mantic practice. 6) Conclusion: BaZi’s calendar is continuous with Daoist historicization of the cosmic person.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat major luck pillars as personal 'nianpu of the Dao'—chapters of one principle in different masks. 2) When advising, date transformations; avoid eternal abstractions without year nodes. 3) Align ritual/cultivation intensives with chart-supported years as the nianpu aligns theophany with eras. 4) Study Laozi’s multiple appearances as model for Day Master expressing through different 十神 roles. 5) Use outline (要略) discipline: compress client life to essential dated nodes first.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 太上混元老子史略, which emphasizes primordial fusion (混元), the 年谱要略 prioritizes dated serial form. It differs from 洞仙传’s many-person immortality catalog by centering one cosmic identity across times. Why: chronology itself is the proof structure.

entries.logic_thesis: The historical outline of Hunyuan Laozi proves that primordial chaos-unity (混元) and the named sage Laozi are one continuum, not two subjects. Origin metaphysics and biographical history collapse into a single causal story: the world unfolds from mixed origin through a teaching person. Thus personal cultivation aims to reverse-engineer biography back into 混元.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Philosophy splits 'principle' from 'person'. 2) Daoist history fuses them as 混元老子. 3) If fusion is true, reading either alone is partial. 4) Cosmogony→sage acts→teaching transmission form one chain. 5) Inference: fate of persons participates in cosmogonic leftover order. 6) Conclusion: BaZi charts are local crystallizations of 混元 differentiation (阴阳五行), readable toward re-integration.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Begin advanced readings from Taiji/混元: before listing gods, state the chart’s primary polar tension. 2) Practice reverse sequence: from current events back to Day Master root, then to prenatal Taiji image. 3) Cultivation: hunyuan breathing—mix, don’t chase single phase peaks. 4) When many 十神 clutter, re-merge categories until one generative conflict remains. 5) Use '史略' compression: refuse trivia that doesn’t serve origin logic.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 年谱要略, this text’s logic is cosmogonic fusion more than date tables. Unlike 玄元十子图, which multiplies disciples, it unifies identity at the source. Why: 混元 is the master operator—mixture prior to and within history.

entries.logic_thesis: Biographies of cave immortals prove that localized sacred space (洞天) plus practice can rewrite the apparent finality of ordinary destiny. The collection argues by case gallery: transformation is plural in method but unitary in structure (exit ordinary calibration). Immortality narrative functions as existence proof for non-linear fate.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Ordinary biography ends in decay and social closure. 2) Cave-heaven practice reports alternate endings. 3) Multiple independent cases share motifs: discipline, locale, transmission, verification signs. 4) Shared motifs imply a trainable pattern, not unique miracle. 5) Inference: allotment (命) is conditional on practice regime and place-qi. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 'fixed fate' is a baseline; cultivation is a legal amendment procedure within Daoist physics.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify chart 'cave entries': 印星, mountains, solitude, study—portals for rewrite. 2) Prescribe place and schedule (洞天 analogue: retreat room, hours) matching favorable branches. 3) Track verification signs (health, dream, synchronicity) as hagiographies track proofs. 4) For heavy 伤官 without output path, design a craft-immortality route (skill as ascent). 5) Never promise literal transcendence; use the structure: baseline chart → practice amendment → re-measured outcomes.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike imperial steles that prove 感应 for dynasty, 洞仙传 proves it for private ascent. It differs from 徐神翁语录, which stresses knowing allotted number, by stressing transformation narratives. Why: the cave is a logic of spatial exception—place enables exception to average fate.

entries.name_han: 虚静冲和先生徐神翁语录
entries.logic_thesis: Xu Shenweng’s recorded sayings prove that human use of life is bounded by heaven, allotment, portion, and number (天/命/分/数), which cannot be altered by raw will; ignorance of principle creates the need for a seer who has already obtained the mind-pattern. Divination is not creation of fate but disclosure of a pre-structured field. Stillness and harmony (虚静冲和) are the epistemic virtues that make disclosure accurate.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: People experience life as choosable at every point. 2) Outcomes repeatedly show fixed bounds (分定). 3) Failure to '穷理' yields self-ignorance. 4) One who has prior grasp of the pattern can speak fortune/misfortune reliably. 5) Inference: mantic authority rests on mind-alignment, not performance tricks. 6) Conclusion: BaZi practice must combine numerical structure with 虚静—without stillness, number becomes noise.
entries.logic_practice: 1) State client constraints (分/数) before strategies; refuse 'anything is possible' coaching. 2) Pre-reading protocol: 虚静—breath and empty agenda, then open the chart. 3) When 冲和 is missing (internal conflict), delay prediction; regulate first. 4) Teach clients which sectors are hard allotment vs soft timing. 5) Model Xu’s low status service (sweeping) as training: humble roles refine perception of pattern.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 洞仙传’s rewrite-through-ascent gallery, Xu’s logic prioritizes knowing the allotted measure. It differs from 开元占经’s vast external omen tables by centering the seer’s 虚静 mind as instrument. Why: the yu lu form proves through aphoristic cases that fate-disclosure is ethical-epistemic, not merely technical.

entries.logic_thesis: Portraits and lives of the Ten Masters of Mysterious Origin prove that one Dao-source generates multiple valid disciple temperaments and methods. Diversity of transmission is evidence of the source’s fertility, not of schism alone. Image + biography together argue that lineage is a structured plurality under Xuanyuan.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Orthodoxy often collapses into one heir style. 2) Ten named disciples embody distinct approaches from one Laozi-root. 3) Portraiture freezes difference as simultaneous truth. 4) Shared origin + distinct paths imply generative unity. 5) Inference: evaluating a path requires locating which '子' function it enacts. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 十神 can be read as disciple-functions of one Day Master origin—plural roles, one root.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map client’s strong 十神 to disciple archetypes (e.g. 食伤 as free wanderer type, 正官 as order-keeper type). 2) Advise path diversification when chart shows multiple viable outputs—don’t force one school. 3) Use image-meditation: visualize roles rather than only verbal rules. 4) Cultivation: study one classic per 'disciple gate' to avoid monocular Dao. 5) In teacher selection, match temperament (子) to chart, not fame alone.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 太上老君年谱’s single-identity serial timeline, 玄元十子图 multiplies persons under one title. It differs from 洞仙传’s open immortal crowd by fixed decade of philosophical heirs. Why: the number ten and the portrait genre are logical devices for structured plurality.

entries.name_han: 大唐嵩阳观纪圣德感应之颂
entries.logic_thesis: The Songyang Abbey stele proves that imperial virtue and Daoist sanctuary co-produce publicly testable 感应 (stimulus-response) between human order and cosmic power. Sacred architecture and political morality form a joint experimental apparatus: when virtue is claimed, heaven’s response is inscribed as evidence. Legitimacy is argued as reciprocal causation, not mere force.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Dynasty claims mandate. 2) Mandate requires non-human confirmation. 3) Daoist holy site is designated sensor and amplifier. 4) Recorded wonders link royal de/virtue to cosmic reply. 5) Inference: politics and cultivation share one response physics. 6) Conclusion: BaZi state-luck and personal luck both obey 感应 pairing—inner quality with outer timing.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Pair any major luck claim with a virtue/conduct variable—don’t predict from symbols alone. 2) Treat temples, mountains, and fixed altars as chart-external nodes of 得地. 3) For leaders’ charts, read 官印 as Songyang-type apparatus: institution as response surface. 4) Cultivation: make one practice site stable enough to 'inscribe' results over years. 5) When 感应 fails, audit virtue and site before rewriting theory.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike private 洞仙传 proofs, this is public-imperial demonstration literature. It differs from 升仙太子碑 by focusing on abbey-state resonance rather than a single apotheosized prince. Why: the genre is 颂—praise as logical seal on the response experiment.

entries.logic_thesis: The Stele of the Crown Prince Who Ascended to Immortality proves that political authority can bind itself to a personal apotheosis narrative, making transcendence a technology of rule and of aspiration simultaneously. Wu Zhao’s inscription argues that history, calligraphy, and ritual stone fix a pathway from mortal rank to immortal status. The proof structure is performative: the stele does not only report ascent—it institutes it as model.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Rank alone does not guarantee sacred permanence. 2) Immortalization narrative supplies permanence. 3) Stone inscription publicizes and stabilizes the narrative. 4) Sovereign sponsorship fuses state cult with personal ascent template. 5) Inference: fate elevation can be ritually-politically engineered within Daoist symbolic law. 6) Conclusion: BaZi 'rising' luck includes symbolic-institutional acts, not only silent waiting for stems.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For charts with strong 食伤 + 官, design a visible masterwork (stele-analogue) that locks identity transformation. 2) Time publications, renamings, and vows to supportive luck pillars. 3) Distinguish empty self-myth from stele-logic: public verifiable change + craft. 4) Cultivation: write a personal '碑'—concise vows and evidence of practice. 5) Read 羊刃/权 patterns carefully: ascent rhetoric can mask coercion; demand ethical alignment.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 龙角山庆唐观纪圣铭, which sacralizes dynasty founding theophany, this stele personalizes ascent in a princely figure under female sovereign authorship. It differs from 洞仙传 by being a single monumental proof-object. Why: the stele medium is the argument—durability as logical force.

entries.logic_thesis: The Longjiao Mountain inscription proves that Tang founding is to be read as cosmological theophany, not merely military success: dynasty birth is a Daoist event with site, vision, and commemorative abbey. Sacred geography certifies political origin. The argument binds mountain qi, ancestral spirit signs, and state cult into one causal bundle.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Conquest narratives risk looking like contingent violence. 2) Theophany narratives reframe conquest as response to higher order. 3) Fixed mountain and abbey provide permanent coordinates for the claim. 4) Inscription freezes the origin story as ongoing cult. 5) Inference: origin qi of a polity (or person) needs a geographic-ritual anchor. 6) Conclusion: BaZi year pillar / ancestral palace reading should include place of origin and cultic memory, not only numerical stems.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Always note birthplace mountain-water pattern as Longjiao-type origin qi. 2) For family luck, track ancestral shrine / hometown returns as 感应 nodes. 3) When 年柱 is strong, ask what founding myth the family lives by—rewrite if toxic. 4) Cultivation: pilgrimage or fixed mountain practice to stabilize origin. 5) In state-level symbolism for leaders, map 建禄/帝旺 to '庆唐' founding peaks—dangerous if inflated.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 嵩阳观颂’s general virtue-response praise, 龙角山铭 is origin-specific founding theology. It differs from 升仙太子碑’s personal apotheosis by centering dynastic birth and mountain. Why: geography + founding moment is the logical core.

entries.logic_thesis: The Kaiyuan treatise on divination proves that celestial and meteorological signs form a systematic, taxonomic science of correspondence to state and human outcomes—prediction as classified knowledge, not pure inspiration. Exhaustive cataloguing argues that completeness of sign inventory increases reliability of inference. The sky is a readable code with rules of combination, hierarchy, and historical precedent.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Omens appear chaotic if unindexed. 2) Indexing by type, location, and co-occurrence creates a code. 3) Historical cases attach outcomes to code entries. 4) Rule extraction from cases yields transferable diagnostics. 5) Inference: fate knowledge scales with catalog quality and disciplined matching. 6) Conclusion: BaZi is a sibling science—stem-branch taxonomy plus case binding—subject to the same completeness and correspondence ethics.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build personal '占经' tables: chart pattern → outcome frequency, not only classical quotes. 2) Never read one sign alone; require co-occurrence rules as 开元 does with multi-phenomena. 3) Separate state-level omen logic from private charts—scale mismatch is error. 4) Cultivation: sky-gazing with logbook—train correspondence perception. 5) When modern data contradict a classical line, update the catalog; taxonomy is living.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike biji that prove by sparse anecdote, 开元占经 proves by encyclopedic system. It differs from 徐神翁语录’s mind-stillness emphasis by externalizing authority into sky tables—yet both assume lawful pattern. Why: the Kaiyuan project is imperial completeness; its logic is that missing entries, not missing magic, cause failure.
